description: The plot illustrates how MRR@10 varies with the number of queries used during inference (S) for several DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S)” on a linear scale, spanning 1 to 10 with integer tick marks. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5 with ticks every 0.5. Six colored lines with circular markers are shown: the black solid line labeled “DPR w/o query” is a flat horizontal baseline at approximately 34.2 across all S values; the yellow solid line labeled “DPR w/ gold” starts near 33.0 at S=1, rises gradually through the mid-33s by around S=5–6, and reaches about 34.9 by S=10; the green solid line labeled “DPR w/ top-1” begins near 33.0 at S=1, increases sharply to about 34.7 at S=2, continues upward to roughly 35.5 by S=4, and ends near 36.4 at S=10; the purple solid line labeled “DPR w/ bottom-1” starts around 34.8 at S=1, peaks near 35.1 around S=3, then trends downward and fluctuates slightly, ending around 34.7 at S=10; the blue solid line labeled “DPR w/ random” starts near 34.8 at S=1, rises to about 35.2–35.3 by S=3–4, stays close to ~35.2 for most intermediate S values, and ends around 35.3 at S=10; the red solid line labeled “DPR w/ curriculum” starts around 35.2 at S=1, increases to about 35.6 by S=2–3, then remains near 35.7–35.8 through S=10 with small fluctuations. Several dashed horizontal reference lines in matching colors appear near the corresponding series levels (e.g., around ~35.6 in red, ~35.2 in blue, ~34.9 in purple, and ~34.6 in green).
